يهز (form I)
# يَهُزُّ (yahuzzu) /ja.huz.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of هَزَّ (hazza)
# يُهَزُّ (yuhazzu) /ju.haz.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of هَزَّ (hazza)
# يَهُزَّ (yahuzza) /ja.huz.za/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of هَزَّ (hazza)
# يُهَزَّ (yuhazza) /ju.haz.za/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
